Narin.name: Narin
Narin.description: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.

Kuva Ghoulsaw.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
Kuva Ghoulsaw.description: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

Sagek Prime.name: Sagek Prime
Sagek Prime.description: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.

Akarius.name: Akarius
Akarius.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

Afentis Prime.name: Afentis Prime
Afentis Prime.description: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.

Lato Vandal.name: Lato Vandal
Lato Vandal.description: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

Akmagnus Prime.name: Akmagnus Prime
Akmagnus Prime.description: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.

Sarofang Prime.name: Sarofang Prime
Sarofang Prime.description: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.

Athodai Prime.name: Athodai Prime
Athodai Prime.description: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on Weak Point kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

Wrath.name: Wrath
Wrath.description: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.

Vadarya Prime.name: Vadarya Prime
Vadarya Prime.description: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.

Twin Kohmak.name: Twin Kohmak
Twin Kohmak.description: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.

Pride.name: Pride
Pride.description: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

Styanax Prime.name: Styanax Prime
Styanax Prime.description: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.

Corvas Prime.name: Corvas Prime
Corvas Prime.description: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.

Corufell Prime.name: Corufell Prime
Corufell Prime.description: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

Kestrel Prime.name: Kestrel Prime
Kestrel Prime.description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

Braton Vandal.name: Braton Vandal
Braton Vandal.description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

Cinta.name: Cinta
Cinta.description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

Perigale Prime.name: Perigale Prime
Perigale Prime.description: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.

Citrine Prime.name: Citrine Prime
Citrine Prime.description: The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.

Haalvu.name: Haalvu
Haalvu.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

Thornbak.name: Thornbak
Thornbak.description: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.

Gyre Prime.name: Gyre Prime
Gyre Prime.description: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.

Akvasto Prime.name: Akvasto Prime
Akvasto Prime.description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.

Steflos Prime.name: Steflos Prime
Steflos Prime.description: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.

Venato.name: Venato
Venato.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

Voruna Prime.name: Voruna Prime
Voruna Prime.description: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.

Morgha.name: Morgha
Morgha.description: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.

Alternox Prime.name: Alternox Prime
Alternox Prime.description: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.

Sporothrix.name: Sporothrix
Sporothrix.description: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.

Korrudo.name: Korrudo
Korrudo.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

Spectra Vandal.name: Spectra Vandal
Spectra Vandal.description: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.

Venato Prime.name: Venato Prime
Venato Prime.description: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against 'common enemies' of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.

Arum Spinosa.name: Arum Spinosa
Arum Spinosa.description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

Daikyu Prime.name: Daikyu Prime
Daikyu Prime.description: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.

Athodai.name: Athodai
Athodai.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

Galariak Prime.name: Galariak Prime
Galariak Prime.description: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

Hespar.name: Hespar
Hespar.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.
